== Members by Declaration ==
Due to problems with spam you'll need to request an account on the wiki.  Email Brandon@THISDOMAIN.org if you'd like an account.

If you find yourself resonating with the values expressed in the [[SolSeedMovement]] and would like to join, please read the [[SolSeedCreed]] page and then sign your name and the date in the space provided below.  Then head on over to [[Getting Involved]] and figure out your program :-)

If you are less sure but would like to receive monthly updates on what we're doing, see [[FriendsOfSolSeed]].

Your signature implies endorsement of the core values of the [[SolSeedMovement]], with the awareness that those values may change and grow as a result of your participation.

After reading the [[SolSeedCreed]], I have decided to Join the [[SolSeedMovement]]::
